sourceReviewStatus: Independent delta review pending; final judge requires parent-verified completion; blinded release-only collection may proceed with immutable runtime source
blindingProcedure: Independent author outputs mechanically parsed only to project id/query/mode manifests, check counts and hashes. No final query or gold values displayed or inspected by parent before this policy commit. Source/prompt/route/scoring criteria frozen before manual semantic read.

collection.budgetSemantics: cooperative elapsed window, checked between Fast decompilations; not a hard interruption of synchronous analysis
collection.queryOrder: frozen independent author order per game
collection.history: one fresh release product process per game; cumulative canonical member index and recovered evidence retained across author-fixed query order, recorded in beforeCount and recovery baseline

representations.A0: Hex before owner extension, captured baseline key
representations.A: Hex after staged recovery, unchanged local ranking
representations.R1: legacy binary method-role comparator diagnostic only; not acceptance baseline
representations.V4: exact jevArgumentFlowRequest; release function and bounded proven machine input/write/access context
representations.S4: exact V4 plus object-context-v4 route, unique local accessor and caller-input/literal-marker preservation, conflict/truncation/actual-visible-context equivalence veto; fallback to A

defaultScope: S4 only partial interactive anonymous C++ semantic member queries satisfying the exact frozen route; strong/exact/named/ObjC retained. No remote retrieval or bulk per-member calls. Default remains disabled until measured gain and preservation/gates pass.
metrics: raw selected-choice correctness and high-confidence errors
reranking failure conditional on actual recovery/publication/shortlist

decisions.DEFAULT_ON: V4 >=2 net rescues over O4 independently in each game; gold lattice recall>=50%; zero regression against A0/A/O4 in every repeat; no destructive instability/false strong/unsafe confident; >=15 distinct baseline-correct preservation cases including>=5 real anonymous C++ weak; member API p95<=1000ms; API error<=5%; fail-closed/platform/canonical/exact-head gates green
decisions.SELECTIVE_DEFAULT_ON: S4 >=1 net rescue over O4 independently in each game; zero regression against A0/A/O4 in every repeat; same distinct preservation/unsafe/strong/destructive-instability/latency/error/gate bars; only exact pre-frozen S4 route. Report recall/semantic coverage and cumulative recovery limitations. Remote retrieval gains cannot substitute.
decisions.OPTIONAL_ADVISORY: At least1 V4 improvement over O4 overall with A/A0 correct results preserved; historical decision only, does not fulfill requested default-quality objective
decisions.NO_GO: otherwise do not activate remote production preference; generic deterministic improvements may ship. User default-quality objective remains unfinished and any source/prompt changes after these outcomes require a new untouched independent judge.

preservationPanel: Distinct actual cases, not repetitions counted as new cases. Include SP08/SP33/XA40, correct named/strong controls and >=5 weak anonymous actual game cases; select baseline-correct criteria independent of Jev outcomes.
unsafeConfidentDefinition: Committed unsupported strong binary verdict, reported separately from raw remote high-confidence wrong picks (pick>=0.9 and unique>=0.9); no threshold routing
abstainDefinition: Controls have no verified semantic target; record forced weak preferences separately from actual abstention and unsupported strong. A remote weak choice never becomes proof.
